description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Tabs' that renders a minimalist horizontal tab interface. The component displays a list of buttons styled as tabs, allows setting an active tab, and handles tab selection changes via callback. It is designed to be accessible with ARIA roles and labels, and follows a specific style guide for UI consistency.

methods.name: Tabs({ tabs = [], activeKey, onChange, className = "", "aria-label": ariaLabel = "Section tabs", })
